protocol:
1. Fit a sterile disposable pipette tip from the open purple tip box onto a yellow-banded adjustable single-channel micropipette.

2. Label clear snap-cap microtubes/PCR tubes on the caps with a black permanent marker and place the labeled tubes in a teal tube rack.

3. Open the labeled tubes and position the working tubes in the teal and green tube racks on the benchtop.

4. Using the single-channel micropipette, transfer clear liquid between an open labeled snap-cap tube and multiple labeled tubes in the teal rack; no volume setting is visible.

5. Dispense clear liquid into an open labeled snap-cap microtube held by hand, then place the tube upright in the green rack.

6. Pick up a connected strip of clear PCR tubes with open caps and hold the strip above the green rack.

7. Using the yellow-banded single-channel micropipette, dispense clear liquid sequentially into the open tubes of the PCR strip; no volume setting is visible.

8. Set the filled PCR strip/tubes down near the labeled snap-cap tubes in the green rack and place the micropipette back on the benchtop.
